# Orders In Seconds

> > Orders In Seconds provides a free AI-powered wholesale sales assistant for B2B brands and distributors in the United States and Canada.

Orders In Seconds offers artificial intelligence tools specifically designed for wholesale distribution and B2B sales operations. The platform focuses on helping brands streamline their wholesale ordering processes through AI-driven sales assistance and data analysis.

- Wholesale Sales AI Assistant

- United States Market
